expr: (let sortedChords := chords.map (fun chord => let a := chord[0]!; let b := chord[1]!; if a > b then [b, a] else [a, b]); sortedChords.any (fun x => sortedChords.any (fun y => hasChordIntersection_postcond.hasIntersection x y)))

lemmas.name: has_symm13
lemmas.statement: ∀ (x y : List Nat), hasChordIntersection_postcond.hasIntersection x y = hasChordIntersection_postcond.hasIntersection y x
lemmas.proof:
by intro x y
  unfold hasChordIntersection_postcond.hasIntersection
  exact Bool.or_comm _ _

lemmas.name: chord13
lemmas.statement: ∀ (N : Nat) (chords : List (List Nat)) (h : hasChordIntersection_precond N chords), hasChordIntersection_postcond N chords (let sortedChords := chords.map (fun chord => let a := chord[0]!; let b := chord[1]!; if a > b then [b, a] else [a, b]); sortedChords.any (fun x => sortedChords.any (fun y => hasChordIntersection_postcond.hasIntersection x y))) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro N chords h
  unfold hasChordIntersection_postcond
  intro sortedChords
  refine ⟨fun hpw hres => ?_, fun hany => hany⟩
  have hres' : (sortedChords.any (fun x => sortedChords.any (fun y => hasChordIntersection_postcond.hasIntersection x y))) = true := hres
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hy'⟩ := List.any_eq_true.mp hres'
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := List.any_eq_true.mp hy'
  by_cases hxe : x = y
  · subst hxe; rw [has_irr13] at hxy; exact absurd hxy (by simp)
  · haveI : Std.Symm (fun a b : List Nat => (!hasChordIntersection_postcond.hasIntersection a b) = true) := ⟨fun a b h => by simpa [has_symm13 a b] using h⟩
    have hpw' := List.Pairwise.forall hpw hx hy hxe
    simp [hxy] at hpw'
